notes.title: Playtest 2.0
notes.content:
[h3]Available Now![/h3]
After a long time since the last update, here is a massive update bringing multiplayer to Elite Rogue as well as big map changes. 

[h3]The long awaited multiplayer update is finally here! [/h3]
This means you can team up to explore the updated map and the brand new one [u]out now[/u].
The [b]10 player[/b] multiplayer aims to make the roguelike experience a little different from the norm.

[h3]Map Changes[/h3]
The original map has [b]quadrupled[/b] in size and the update also brings a [b]new map[/b] just as big, this means a lot more to explore and there are also a couple of [i]secret [/i]places to be found!
Our newest map [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2304480/view/4442331835939160526?l=english]Electro Caves[/url] is now ready for the public after a lot of tweaks, with it comes [b]new foes[/b] fitting the theme as well as a [b]brand new boss[/b].

[h2]Changes since the first playtest include:[/h2]
[list]
[*] General balancing
[*] Fixed wave system

But that's not all! We're also working on a spectacular VFX update, enhancing the visual appeal of items and various in-game elements. Stay tuned for more details on this exciting addition!

Your positive feedback has been our driving force, and we're grateful for your continued support. To share the joy, here are a few testimonials from our dedicated community:

"This is dope af" 
"Very cool to try this game out!" 
"like the game at this early stage!"

While we won't delve into the nitty-gritty, creating a seamless multiplayer experience is a colossal task. Our dedicated team is committed to overcoming the complexities, making Elite Rogue the best it can be.

The highlight of the upcoming update? Elite Rogue will support up to 10 players! Experience the thrill of a roguelike adventure like never before. Queue up with friends or go solo — the choice is yours.

Big news! We've implemented a new feature based on your feedback. Now, when you pick up items, a handy popup will display with the description and image of the respective items. 

 [h2]🔜Stay Tuned:[/h2]
The big update is around the corner. Thank you for being a vital part of Elite Rogue's journey. Your feedback has shaped this game, and we can't wait to share these exciting additions with you. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready for an epic adventure!

notes.title: Enemy Spotlight - Spawner
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/12b232a0c88131b9347da7913a6b2f132bedd137.png[/img]
[h3]INTRODUCTION:[/h3]
Spawners are elite flying summoner units, known as the "scum of nightmare." They keep their distance from players and birth kamikaze drones that seek and explode on impact. Identifying clueless drones indicates the presence of a nearby spawner.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/d8fd04bafc47b97c855bfbaebf8f313afa56a578.png[/img]
[h3]GAME STATS:[/h3]
Spawner Level 1:
HP: 50
DMG: 34.5
Armor: 1 (Note: Inflicts damage through spawned drones)
[b]HOW TO DEAL WITH IT:[/b]
The Spawner itself deals no damage, but its spawned drones pose a threat. Players need to be prepared to one-shot the drones, while prioritizing the elimination of the Spawner to prevent being overwhelmed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/a1bd426d2f30cecec179d7bd567eae749f330706.png[/img]
[h3]LORE:[/h3]
The Spawner resides in the nightmare dimension, materializing terrors and anxieties. Its mysterious background includes being a former cook for Zahir. The lore is intentionally vague, with room for interpretation. Suggestions are welcome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/21a159b7c8b3651f33f4326ad0692f964774577a.png[/img]
[h3]CONCLUSION:[/h3]
Sharing information before the game's release ensures players are informed and excited. It provides a guide for dealing with the Spawner and adds to the game's lore. The devblog aims to create interest, generate hype, and offer a preview for those wanting to learn more about the game.

notes.title: Devblog - Nightmare overhaul
notes.content:
Now that we've unveiled our first map, the Nightmare Dimension, which will be the playable map in the closed alpha, we want to update you on what we've been working on.

[b]Visual Overhaul:[/b]
We've undertaken a major visual overhaul, as showcased in the before-and-after image below. Shifting from a pink to a more purple color scheme, we've darkened the overall atmosphere of Nightmare to align with our envisioned aesthetic. The addition of a perfectly fitting skybox, though time-consuming, has proven to be well worth the effort. We've also introduced extra detailing, such as torches, and implemented a day/night cycle that enhances immersion. Looking ahead, we might incorporate a weather cycle. Additionally, we've adjusted visibility with fog, enhancing immersion without negatively impacting gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/06dd498d1e606e8e45bc1094321d7e12ef48691b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/007f647cc61dc78d66b8760f87fcd0b3e5be2f79.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay-Related Content: Events:[/b]
Introducing events, which occur both inside sections and between them. Closed-quarters events include:

[olist]
[*] [b]Camps:[/b]
Tribes of huts with enemies and loot. Beware, as entering their territories will enrage them.
[*] [b]Teleporter Portals:[/b]
A chance of being broken, these portals connect to random locations on the map, allowing free movement back and forth.
[*] [b]Boss Altar:[/b]
This self-explanatory feature summons the largest and most fearsome Nightmare entity: Zahir, the incarnation of terror and anxiety. There's only one altar per dimension, and its location is random.
[/olist]

[b]Between Events or Gate Events:[/b]
Guardians of gates, these events act as obstacles for moving from one place to another on foot. A few gate events added include:

[olist]
[*][b] Turret Event:[/b]
Defend turrets from hordes of enemies to pass through this gate.
[*] [b]Crystal Event:[/b]
Search and destroy crystals to charge open the gate.
[*] [b]Gatekeeper Event:[/b]
These keepers defend gates with their lives!
[/olist]

notes.title: Behind the veil - Nightmare Dimension
notes.content:
🌌[h3] Welcome to Nightmare: The Abyss of Fears[/h3]

Descend into the ethereal realm known as Nightmare, a dimension where the very fabric of terror takes shape. In the cosmic tapestry of this haunting realm, you confront the core fears and terrors that reside in the shadows of every living being.

🎨 [h3]A Dark Symphony of Colors[/h3]

The canvas of Nightmare is painted in a dark, ominous palette. A sinister marriage of dark grays and purples envelops the landscape, creating an otherworldly ambiance. Illuminated by eerie purple lightning, the terrain reveals a strange dichotomy—hues of darkness set against vivid purple elements. The grass whispers fears, water shivers with dread, and flames dance in the hues of malevolence.

👻 [h3]Guardians of the Abyss
[/h3]
In this macabre theater, you encounter the ghouls—sentinels of terror. These spectral entities, clad in haunting light grey armor, wander the desolate landscape. Their twisted forms are a spectral green, a complement to the ominous purple surroundings. Each ghoul bears the weight of fears and nightmares, materialized to ensure they are never questioned, only feared.

⚔️ [h3]Face the Unfathomable[/h3]

Your journey through Nightmare is a confrontation with terror itself. The ghouls, with swords and laser guns in hand, stand as the guardians of the core fears that materialize in this dimension. It is a place where fears take tangible form, and you must navigate this eerie landscape, confronting the very essence of terror to overcome the nightmares that lurk in the shadows.

🔮 [h3]Beyond the Horizon of Fear[/h3]

As you delve deeper into Nightmare, the mysteries unfold, and the true nature of terror reveals itself. The dimension challenges your courage, pushing you to face the darkest corners of the subconscious. Will you emerge unscathed, or succumb to the nightmares that seek to consume you?

🌌 [h3]Nightmare: Where Fears Take Flight[/h3]
Start your journey into the core of Nightmare, where fear materializes and anxieties come to life.  Fend the ghouls, explore the purple-tainted void and solve the riddles of that which lies beyond the veil of fear.

notes.title: Empower your journey - Lightning Bolt
notes.content:
Discover the enchanting tale of a sparkly bolt that detached from Zeus's gaming chair, bouncing off the clouds and gracefully descending into a young man's lap. Intrigued, he brought this mystical bolt home for closer inspection, leading to a startling revelation: when this bolt is affixed onto an object, it initiates a unique charging process.

Explore the possibilities! What additional capabilities does this magical bolt possess? Can you envision a more innovative and practical use for it? Uncover the potential of this extraordinary bolt and its fascinating abilities.

notes.title: Lorenzo Tattagila: The Cheesy Conqueror of Electro Island!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave adventurers! A new threat has emerged on the mystical Electro Island, and his name is Lorenzo Tattagila. This rogue has established his base of operations and proudly proclaims himself as the island's lord and savior, convinced that the gods themselves are in his favor. Why, you ask? Because every Sunday, cheese rains from the skies!

But don't be fooled, for there may be more to this cheesy spectacle than meets the eye. Whispers among the locals suggest that Lorenzo's so-called "godly" powers are not what they seem. It's said that a mysterious figure known as Dr. Schneider may be pulling the strings behind the scenes.


When Lorenzo isn't busy reveling in his cheesy miracles, you can find him in his exclusive "Rat Club" or aboard his luxurious yacht. The Rat Club is his secret lair where he and his loyal followers congregate to discuss their grandiose plans and indulge in their love for all things rodent-related. And if you're lucky enough to score an invite, you might just uncover the secrets of his cheese-powered empire.

Are you daring enough to challenge Lorenzo Tattagila, the self-proclaimed Cheesy Conqueror of Electro Island? Will you uncover the truth behind the cheese rains and the enigmatic Dr. Schneider? Prepare yourselves, adventurers, for an epic roguelike adventure that will take you to the very heart of this cheesy mystery! 🧀🗝️🌩️

notes.title: Empower Your Journey - Bull's Eye
notes.content:
The Bull's Eye is a mystical artifact in the shape of a perfectly preserved bull's eye, radiating an aura of precision and intensity.
When held, it grants its bearer the uncanny ability to strike their foes with unparalleled precision, doubling their critical chance.
This remarkable power is said to be bestowed by the ancient Bull Spirit, guardian of accuracy and aim, who seeks champions to carry on its legacy.
